payload.rewritten_goal:
Run an outsourced cloud-partnership renewal review using the provided Huawei and Alibaba contract documents. Before replying with the final recommendation summary, the team must: 1. inspect the contract terms, pricing, and support obligations,
2. retrieve the current renewal record and cloud budget lines,
3. determine the budget-feasible renewal path,
4. route the renewal record to the correct governance owner,
5. create one follow-up record for the approved next step.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- supplier huawei contract: Cloud Server Leasing Contract document for Huawei ECS service showing a monthly fee of CNY 45,000 plus handwritten edits increasing the scope to 20 units and CNY 90,000 per month. Extracted content: Supplier Huawei Contract Cloud Server Leasing Contract document for Huawei ECS service showing a monthly fee of CNY 45,000 plus handwritten edits increasing the scope to 20 units and CNY 90,000 per month. Details Document Title Cloud Server Leasing Contract Supplier Name Huawei Cloud Service Name Elastic Cloud Server (ECS) Billing Term monthly Original Monthly Fee Cny 45000 Handwritten Scope Change Units 20 Handwritten Revised Monthly Fee Cny 90000 Contract Contains Handwritten Edits true Pricing Currency CNY Document Describes Server Leasing Services true Additional Information a realistic 2-page enterprise contract document in English with some standard Chinese commercial phrasing On page 1, include a clean typed pricing section showing a monthly recurring fee and service quantity details Then visually add obvious handwritten-style annotations in dark blue or black ink near the pricing/scope area that revise the service scope and replace the monthly total, with strike-throughs or margin notes indicating approval-style edits realistic support obligations, uptime/service language, and standard legal boilerplate This contract is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- supplier aliyun contract: Cloud Service Leasing Contract document for Alibaba Cloud RDS and CDN services at CNY 38,000 per month with 99.99% database availability. Extracted content: Supplier Aliyun Contract Cloud Service Leasing Contract document for Alibaba Cloud RDS and CDN services at CNY 38,000 per month with 99.99% database availability.
